tools.name: aegis_scan
tools.description: Call before editing files: returns the governance rules that apply to them, ranked by ledger fitness and clamped to the JIT token budget. Mandatory rules (gates, invariants) take at most two slots; the others are listed in omitted_mandatory. stale_rules lists rules edited since the last aegis sync. If any rule file cannot be loaded the scan fails (status FAIL) and names it.

files.description: Workspace-relative files you are about to edit. Defaults to the git diff.

view.description: Optional response projection: full (default), summary or ids.

tools.name: aegis_report_outcome
tools.description: Report whether the rules you were shown helped. The server ties the report to the tree it computes now: with an `aegis check --record` run of exactly that tree it credits the rules it showed you that match the change (your rules_used is not what is credited), and even then only CI on the landing commit makes it count; without one it records a single unwitnessed claim per session and tree that earns nothing. Reports per session are capped.

idempotency_key.description: Unique key for this report. Retrying with the same key never records twice.

rules_used.description: Names of the rules this outcome is about, as aegis_scan returned them.

files.description: Optional: the files this change edited (workspace-relative). They measure scan-before-edit compliance (aegis status --compliance); they credit no rule.

view.description: Optional response projection: full (default), summary or ids.

tools.name: aegis_create_rule
tools.description: Turn a natural language concern into a prompt that drafts a governance rule. It writes nothing: save the drafted rule under .aegis/rules/ yourself.

tools.name: aegis_list_rules
tools.description: List the governance rules as {rules, stale_rules, ignored}: every rule with its type, hypothesis and ledger fitness (a file that cannot be loaded is listed with _error), the rules edited since the last aegis sync, and markdown under .aegis/rules that is not a rule.

view.description: Optional response projection: full (default), summary or ids.
